title: Direct Response Copywriting & Ad Creative
description: Write high-converting ad copy and direct response landing page copy. Tests persuasion principles, AIDA framework, and copywriting style.

seo.overviewBody: Copywriting is the art of persuasive writing that drives measurable customer action. Marketing managers look for writers who master direct-response frameworks (PAS, AIDA, BAB), write high-converting landing page headlines, refine value propositions, and craft clear CTAs.

deliverables.title: 1. Conversion Copywriting Portfolio
deliverables.desc: Copy portfolio featuring landing page headlines, ad creative copy variants, email sequences, and product descriptions.

deliverables.title: 2. Value Proposition & Messaging Matrix
deliverables.desc: Matrix defining target audience pain points, feature-to-benefit transformations, and objection handling copy.

deliverables.title: 3. Copy A/B Testing Analysis Report
deliverables.desc: Performance report tracking click-through rate (CTR) differences across headline and CTA button copy variants.

faqs.question: What is the PAS (Problem-Agitate-Solve) copywriting framework?
faqs.answer: PAS introduces the reader's specific pain point (Problem), amplifies the emotional/financial cost of leaving it unfixed (Agitate), and presents the product as the clear remedy (Solve).

faqs.question: How do you write compelling Call-To-Action (CTA) button copy?
faqs.answer: Use action-oriented first-person or benefit-driven phrases (e.g. 'Get My Free Guide' or 'Start 14-Day Free Trial') instead of generic 'Submit' or 'Click Here'.

faqs.question: What is the difference between features and benefits?
faqs.answer: Features describe what a product has or does (e.g. 256GB storage). Benefits explain the positive outcome or relief it brings to the user (e.g. store 50,000 photos without running out of space).
